title: Caller describes chest pain, agent keeps booking

transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to see Dr. Smith. I've had chest pain and my left arm is numb since this morning.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can help you book an appointment with Dr. Smith. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Marcus Bell, March third, nineteen seventy-one. It's kind of getting worse.
Thank you, Marcus. Are you a new patient or an existing patient?
Welcome. What insurance provider do you have?
